item_name: Rothco G.I. Style Mini Alice Pack
item_short_desc: Rothco’s G.I. Style Mini Alice Pack is modeled after the historic 1960’s U.S. Army Design that was utilized by soldiers during the Vietnam War. This tactical pack is perfect for MilSim players.
description: Rothco's G.I. Style Mini Alice Pack features shoulder straps, 3 outside pockets and measures 14 1/2" x 12" x 7". ALICE stands for All-Purpose Lightweight Individual Carrying Equipment system and was adopted by the United States Army in the 1960's to help soldiers carry large heavy packs.
